customManagers.description: Percona Server is pinned as an apt version; track it through the upstream Docker Hub tags, which carry the same version-release string
Same for XtraBackup, which has its own version line and must stay in the server's series

packageRules.description: Auto-merge base image digest/patch refreshes once CI is green
Minor/major base bumps stay as PRs for review
Stay on the 8.4 LTS series: 9.x is a different repository channel (pdps-84-lts) and an in-place datadir upgrade nobody should merge unattended
A database server version is never auto-merged: the datadir upgrades in place on first start and does not go back
Keep the floating @v1 ref to our reusable workflows
